expense_pattern=re.compile(r"^-\s*(?P<payer>[^ ]+?)\s+paid\s+\$(?P<amount>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s+for\s+\"(?P<desc>[^\"]+)\"\.\s+Owed\s+equally\s+by\s+(?P<debtors>.+)\.?$", re.IGNORECASE)

# parse debtor list like 'A and B' or 'A, B and C'

def parse_debtors(text):
    t=text.strip()
    # remove trailing period if any
    t=t[:-1] if t.endswith('.') else t
    # Replace ' and ' with ', ' then split
    t=t.replace(' and ', ', ')
    parts=[p.strip() for p in t.split(',') if p.strip()]
    return parts

        payer=m.group('payer')
        amount=float(m.group('amount'))
        desc=m.group('desc')
